reasoning: The January 2013 meeting continues the identical policy regime established in December 2012: $45B/month Treasury purchases, $40B/month MBS purchases, 0-0.25% fed funds rate, and the same unemployment/inflation thresholds for forward guidance. The only notable development is an internal discussion flagging a planned March review of asset purchase efficacy and costs, but no operational change was made. The statement language is substantively identical to December 2012.
key_quote: The Desk is directed to continue purchasing longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of about $45 billion per month and to continue purchasing agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of about $40 billion per month.
